name: issue-resolver/sensitive-change-tiny
prompt: An XS one-line auth change must still trigger the sensitive-change gate; a lone low-confidence blocker stops it until a cited rebuttal closes it (issue #518)

grade.label: gate outcomes recorded: triggered, stop on the singleton blocker, proceed after a cited rebuttal
the auto-mode stop maps to the existing `failed` run-log outcome
the grader is not vacuous — an absent artifact fails

criteria: The gate fires on an XS change because of what it touches, not its size.
Each probe names the observation that would refute it.
The singleton blocker is reported and held, not dropped for low confidence.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in exercises the real gi-sensitive.py over a fixture ledger, not live agent behavior.
